title: The Sapphire Ascent Phantom Rite
summary: The school rite of the Sapphire Ascent Academy that raises a prismatic phantom out of the student's own light and spends it in one resplendent release.

title: The Nine Halls Rite of Standing Doubles
summary: The rite of the Nine Halls that stands the student's doubles in a line no soul-assault can cross and ends in their united reproach.

title: The Lyraen Heights Rite of the Walking Soul
summary: The rite of the Lyraen Heights Academy for the soul anchored to its Core that sends a whole entity walking apart from the body.

title: The Stormbreak Phantom Rite
summary: The rite of the Stormbreak Academy that drives phantoms like a squall front and breaks a guard under the weight of their onrush.

title: The Oath-Voices' Rite of the Sworn Double
summary: The rite of the Oath-Voices that binds a double to a spoken covenant and sets it to guard the sworn against any who would break faith.

title: The Aerie Rite of the Free Phantom
summary: The rite of the Aerie Academy for the soul with a domain of its own that lets a phantom roam free and act on its own judgment.
